title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
reason: Frontier-lab announcement of GPT-6 protein-design capability with lab-validated binding results is frontier-shifting.

sources.summary: GPT-6 models design protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code. Lab tests found evidence of binding across five targets.

title: Italy’s UniCredit launches six-year bitcoin certificate with gains capped at 65%
reason: Major bank bringing a bitcoin product to roughly 8 million retail customers is a notable adoption milestone.

sources.summary: UniCredit brings bitcoin investing to its roughly 8 million retail customers in Italy, offering them a six-year product that caps the redemption value but promises to return their capital.
